rapport_notes: Genuinely personable -- looked up the destination house on Zillow to visualize the access concern, chatted naturally about being a repeat customer.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before that do you have any concern about the moving process?" -- asked only right before the pricing discussion, after the full intake was already done
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: customer answered 'No' to the concern question, so nothing to dig into
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if ever the move takes less than this, then you will only be charged for how much time we use during the move"

top_strength: Proactively looked up the destination property to confirm the access concern (one step at the front door) instead of just taking the customer's word, building real credibility.
coaching_note: Asked a version of the agenda/concerns question, but only after all the logistics probing was already done -- moving it to the very start of the call would double as the quid pro quo moment too.
